newsitem.title: USA: AccuMed patent gets intl recognition.
newsitem.headline: AccuMed patent gets intl recognition.

text.p: AccuMed International Inc said Tuesday that the London-based International Patent and Trademark Office acknowledged its broad claim patent for a cytological specimen analysis system.
The patent covers a digitized image reference system that provides on-line access to integrated patient demographic and medical history data to support specimen classification and diagnosis.

"This patent will further strengthen AccuMed's technological position in the cytopathology field and will contribute to the broad-based technological cytopathology patents and trade secrets already held by the company," Dr. Norman Pressman, AccuMed's president of cytopathology, said in a statement.
